name: apple-community
description: 高级 iOS 风格社区 App - 参考 Apple 设置 App 设计

scripts.dev: concurrently -n frontend,server -c blue,green "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:server"
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd frontend && npm install && cd ../server && npm install
scripts.build: cd frontend && npm run build && cd ../server && npm run build
scripts.start: concurrently -n frontend,server -c blue,green "npm run start:frontend" "npm run start:server"
